name: exception-resolver-v1
purpose: Offline: for a passage flagged by exception-referent-v1, look for sibling evidence already in the same retrieved section group that says which listed requirement the exception attaches to. If found, bind the exception to that requirement; if not, report 'ambiguous - state it or fetch more'. No generation.
design_choice: Use evidence already in context first (zero extra words); fetch neighbours only when nothing resolves it. Reason: in E23 the resolving passage S044 was already retrieved; the failure was binding, not retrieval.

rule.list_items: the list-item lines before the exception sentence; each reduced to a stem: close, block or list (listing/listed/Stand-in)
rule.exception_tokens: distinctive places or devices in the exception items: Mainland China, Latin America and the Caribbean, Germany, CAT 2
rule.resolver: another passage in the same group whose sentence contains at least one exception token AND exactly one list-item stem
rule.outcome: resolved(stem) if every matching sentence names the same stem; conflicting if sentences name different stems; ambiguous if none

inputs: Saved independent review bundle, all retrieved passages in development cases. No model calls. Holdout not read.

thresholds.T1: E23 S045 resolves to the single stem 'list'
thresholds.T2: no passage in E23 resolves to 'close' or 'block'
thresholds.T3: every flagged passage gets exactly one outcome (resolved, conflicting or ambiguous); none is silently dropped

decision_rule: Pass only if T1 to T3 hold. Report the outcome distribution over all 12 flagged passages without a threshold, and list any resolved passage outside E23 for source review before trusting it.
limits: One known case (E23); written after reading it, so not independent
Token list is Mastercard-guide shaped; unseen sections need new tokens
A resolver sentence in the same group is not proof it covers that exact exception; review before use
